e107Plugin.name: GitHub Sync
e107Plugin.summary: Sync core, plugins, themes and language packs from GitHub repositories
e107Plugin.description: Keeps a table of GitHub sources and syncs each of them into this installation: the core (plus a per-source selection of plugin folders), a single plugin or theme, a theme pack, or a language pack. Each source records the layout of the repository it points at, so Lite and standard e107 repositories can be mixed. Downloads and extracts with its own sync engine.
